items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: I forgot the guy’s name, who was the celebrity that died? Dean? Not Dean. Anyway Pop went up to him...

ctx.x: We were at Sibley’s audition — this was for the big Mickey Mouse Club contest, and Steve won because he could tap dance and play drums. I’ll never forgive him for that. © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-

No, my father went up to — I forgot the guy’s name, who was the celebrity that died? Dean? Not Dean. Anyway Pop went up to him and said, “How come you chose him?” He says, “Well he could tap dance too. Your kids don’t tap dance, they could just play music.”
